change_under_test: 13 EU AI Act annexes ingested (corpus 404 -> 417 rows)
expand_crossrefs(): retrieved articles pull in the annexes they cite, max 2
prediction_written_before_running: The annexes remove one confound but I do NOT expect this to clear zero. The measured problem was that a 0.5B model cannot USE statute even when the right statute is in front of it; giving it MORE statute (article + annex) makes the context longer, not easier. Best case is the delta moves toward zero rather than past it. If it does clear zero I will be surprised and will say so.
success_criterion: delta > 0 AND 95% CI excludes zero. Anything else means retrieval stays OFF.
verdict_rule: Must test SIGN as well as significance. A significant negative is HARM, not a win.

corpus_anchor.note: Anchored retrospectively on 2026-07-29. This records the corpus as it stands NOW; it does not prove what the text said when the result was produced. Runs from this point forward anchor at measurement time.
